title: UAAP: Unbeaten FEU-Diliman, UST on collision course after beating separate foes
summary: Far Eastern University-Diliman and the University of Santo Tomas are still undefeated in the UAAP Season 89 boys' volleyball tournament ahead of their highly-anticipated showdown on Tuesday.
